ideas.title: Investigation into Government Surveillance of Left-Leaning Groups
ideas.description: Investigate the government's surveillance of left-leaning groups during Minnesota unrest and Operation Metro Surge
questions: What was the extent of the government's surveillance?
Were the left-leaning groups targeted unfairly?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant wrongdoing by the government and raise important questions about the balance between national security and civil liberties.
